messages.author: 064d575767319b45
messages.subject: Discussion on creating-cdf-files-from-r-packages-environments
parts:
For Gene ST arrays it appears that pdInfoBuilder will not work if a
transFile argument is specified. Secondly, in the example above
probeFile = "HuGene-1_0-st-v1.probe.tab" is incorrect - it should be
the *.probeset.csv file from Affy. And finally, it also requires that
the MPS (Meta Probeset File) must also be specified using the
coreMps="HuGene-1_0-st-v1.r4.mps". Putting it all together the
following code seems to work:

setwd("\\ANNOTATION\\AffyAnnotation\\Human\\HuGene-1_0-st-v1")
library(pdInfoBuilder)
pgfFile = "HuGene-1_0-st-v1.r4.pgf"
clfFile = "HuGene-1_0-st-v1.r4.clf"
probeFile = "HuGene-1_0-st-v1.na30.1.hg19.probeset.csv"
mpsFile = "HuGene-1_0-st-v1.r4.mps"
pkg <- new("AffyGenePDInfoPkgSeed",
version="1.0.4",
author="Peter White",
email="peter...@nationwidechildrens.org",
biocViews="AnnotationData",
genomebuild="hg19",
organism = "Human", species = "Homo Sapiens",
pgfFile=pgfFile, clfFile=clfFile, coreMps=mpsFile,
probeFile=probeFile)
makePdInfoPackage(pkg, destDir=".")
